from collections import Counter
def symfill(g):
 h=len(g);w=len(g[0]);o=[x[:] for x in g]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   orb={(r,c),(h-1-r,c),(r,w-1-c),(h-1-r,w-1-c)}
   vals=[g[a][b] for a,b in orb if g[a][b]!=3]
   if vals: o[r][c]=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
 return o
